turns.said: What shutter speed should I use at 25 frames a second?
turns.reply:
At 25 fps, use **1/50**.

That's the 180° rule — double the frame rate for the shutter. You're already on it, so you're good.

If you go faster (e.g. 50p) for snappier motion, jump to **1/100**; slower (24p) stays near **1/50**. Going faster than 1/50 at 25 will look choppy; slower will look smeary.
